entities.summary: Malta is a sovereign nation in Southern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Valletta. Official languages include Maltese, English. Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 0.5 million. Area: 316 km². Comprehensive index for Malta covering megalithic temples (~3600 BCE, oldest free-standing structures in world), Phoenician/Carthaginian/Roman rule, Arab conquest (870 CE, Maltese language roots), Norman conquest 1091, Knights Hospitaller/Order of St. John (1530-1798, Great Siege 1565), French occupation (Napoleon 1798), British Crown Colony (1800-1964), George Cross (WWII), independence 1964, Republic 1974, EU 2004.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a strategic location in the Mediterranean, Malta played a crucial role in the Great Siege of 1565, which repelled the Ottoman Empire's invasion. This event had significant regional implications for European politics and trade.
